title: GateDecisionAttestationView
description: Source of truth: DHT (mishpat DNA, GateDecisionAttestation entry, Notarized, Category A). This record is a read-optimised projection populated by the MishpatSignal::GateDecisionCreated post-commit signal. If this projection and the DHT disagree, the DHT wins.

decisionId.description: CID of this attestation (self-addressing, globally unique)

phase.description: Deployment phase under which the gate evaluated the request

elohimId.description: AgentPubKey (base64) of the deciding elohim agent

elohimSubstanceCid.description: CID of the substance declaration (model + constitution) active at decision time

gateName.description: Identifier of the gate that evaluated the request (e.g. 'discernment-gate-v1-mechanical')

gateProcessCid.description: CID of the GateProcessDeclaration DAG that was executed

contextSummaryCid.description: CID of the privacy-respecting GateContext snapshot

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was made

universalBandCid.description: CID of the universal-band DAG declaration active at decision time

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash (base64) of the upstream DHT entry — client can use this to verify provenance

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this projection row was inserted
